title: R2 fix: test.c guard mismatch for crypto2dev_test
description:
In wolfcrypt/test/test.c:
1. The #include of crypto2dev_port.h is nested inside WOLF_CRYPTO_CB (line ~464) but the extern declaration and call site are not, causing linker break when WOLF_CRYPTO_CB is absent.
2. The extern uses plain 'int' but should use wc_test_ret_t to match all neighboring test function declarations.
Fix: add WOLF_CRYPTO_CB to extern and call site guards; change int to wc_test_ret_t in extern.
